independent_checks: Numerical check of the three double Schwinger integrals of Lemma c4-integrals (mpmath, eps = 1e-3, 1e-4, 1e-5): I - (a/eps + b log eps) converges.
Hand re-derivation of every displayed per-graph coefficient in Examples c4-* and c5-*.
Sign of Lemma c4-count from the finite-dimensional C07 formulas (K_0 * x = x checked).
Sign of the anomalous dimension from an explicit momentum-space scaling of O + b log p^2 and from the Callan-Symanzik relation gamma_O = 2b + 2 gamma_phi.
Comparison of the quadratic log counterterms with the standard Feynman-gauge N=4 renormalisation constants (sanity only).
Structural analysis of (d_CE+Q)O[inf] at hbar^0 via the cochain-map property, giving T3-04.
Explicit A|_V-slot zero-mode class phi = x_1 dx_2 (T3-02).

findings.target: ch00 l.26-30; ch05 l.3 and Prop prop:c5-local item 3 (l.57); ch07 Rem rem:c7-content (l.31-33)
findings.gap: (i) The homotopy identity Q(P(0,inf)*a)+P(0,inf)*(Qa)=a on compactly supported a does not dualise to functionals of E_c: P(0,inf)*a is not compactly supported (decays like |x|^-2). ch03 proves acyclicity only for continuous functionals on moment-free Schwartz sections (Cor c3-functionals). (ii) 'finitely many zero-mode classes' is false: ch03 Thm c3-acyclic gives finitely many per polynomial-degree bound, infinitely many in total, and products of them give nonlinear classes. (iii) The list in Thm c3-acyclic (slots c, A|_Wperp, lambda) is not exhaustive and is not claimed to be; e.g. phi = x_1 dx_2 in the A|_V slot has Q phi = -1/2 d^*d phi = 0, the functional e -> <phi,e> = int (phi, e_{A^*|_V}) is Q-closed, and G o Q can depend on e_{A^*|_V} only through d^*e_{A^*|_V}, i.e. through exact phi; since d phi != 0 this class is nontrivial. (iv) 'functional of decaying sections' (ch05) is undefined.
findings.fix: State everywhere what ch03 proves: on moment-free Schwartz sections every Q-closed continuous polynomial functional without constant term is Q-exact (Cor c3-functionals); on E_c, Q has nonzero classes, among them the pairings with polynomial zero modes (finitely many in each degree, infinitely many in all, including A|_V-slot classes modulo exact one-forms). Remove 'finitely many' and 'therefore' in ch00 l.30, ch05 l.3, ch05 Prop c5-local item 3, ch07 Rem c7-content.

findings.verdict: REFUTED as stated (proof gap: locality/power counting assumed, not proved)
findings.target: ch04 Lemma lem:c4-weights (l.341), Prop prop:c4-structure (l.366), Rem rem:c4-thmB (l.24), Def def:c4-ict (l.14); ch05 Prop prop:c5-thmB (l.37); ch00 l.17; ch06 Lemma lem:c6-ct (uniqueness of I^CT)
findings.gap: Lemma c4-weights proves homogeneity of the singular coefficients and concludes their weights only 'whenever these coefficients are local'. Prop c4-structure then uses it unconditionally to kill the eps^{-1/2}, eps^{-3/2} coefficients and all 1PI graphs with >=5 legs (negative superficial degree). A homogeneous function of negative degree vanishes only if it is a polynomial; for graphs with >=5 legs nothing is computed and nothing is proved. Rem c4-thmB states 'locality is a computed property, established below in every sector' and concludes that (eq c4-ict) 'is the one-loop counterterm of [C07, Thm B]' and that the order-hbar flow has a limit; [C07, Thm B] is for compact M and finite T and is not applicable here. Likewise Prop c5-thmB is stated for every local operator of degree 0 but its existence step rests on 'computed explicitly below for every operator of this chapter'. Uniqueness of I^CT (used in Lemma c6-ct, 'For J=I ... uniqueness') is never stated in ch04.
findings.fix: Add a lemma in ch04: for a one-loop graph with numerator homogeneous of degree D_num, after the Gaussian over the loop momentum w_gamma(eps)=int_{[eps,inf)^E} T^{-2-m} N(t/T,p) exp(-T Q(t/T,p)) dt (T = sum t_e); expanding exp(-T Q) in powers of T to order superficial degree/2 leaves an absolutely convergent remainder at eps=0, so the singular part is a polynomial in the leg momenta of degree <= superficial degree, and vanishes for superficial degree < 0. Then Lemma c4-weights applies unconditionally. Add the uniqueness argument of Prop c5-thmB for I^CT. Restrict Prop c5-thmB's existence claim to the operators computed, or rely on the new lemma. Rephrase Rem c4-thmB as 'the analogue on R^4, T=infinity, of the counterterm of [C07, Thm B]'.

findings.target: ch06 Prop prop:c6-classical (l.364), the assumption eq:c6-step2 in Cor cor:c6-dilcomp (l.265), the term list after eq:c6-uvobs (l.354-358), Rem rem:c6-step2 ('for every local operator of degree 0'); ch07 Rem rem:c7-internal (l.154-164) displayed identity
findings.gap: By the UV-boundary identity, at order hbar^0 (d_CE+Q)O[inf] is the flow of (d_CE+Q+{I_g,-})O. Its arity-one component along x_1 is (a) the tree flow of {S^(1)(x_1),O} and (b) the trees with one vertex (Q+{I,-})O and one vertex S^(1)(x_1). Prop c6-classical and the term list of ch06 l.354ff omit (b). For gauge-invariant O, (b)=0 and the statements hold. For the letters (b)!=0: for O = int omega (X, iota_v A|_V), QO = -int omega (X, iota_v dc) is linear, and its c leg joined to the A^*|_V leg of S^(1)(Delta) (or of S^(1)(P_v)) through the c-A^* component of P(0,inf) gives a nonzero linear functional of A|_V, a longitudinal projection of the classical transform. So at hbar^0 the dilatation component of this letter is not 2((E+w_O)O)[inf], and eq c6-step2 cannot hold at order hbar for it. The same holds for Rem c7-internal's '[(d_CE+Q)O[inf]](x_1) = ({S^(1)(x_1),O})[inf]' for translations and gauge-variant O. For iota_wA, lambda, c the extra trees have at least two legs, so the linear coefficients -4, -8, -2 are unaffected. For the scalar bilinears nothing changes.
findings.fix: State Prop c6-classical, eq c6-step2 and the Step-2 task for O with (Q+{I,-})O=0, or add to eq c6-step2 (and to Rem c7-internal) the trees with one vertex (Q+{I,-})O(eps) and one vertex S^(1)(x_1), at order hbar^0 and with their one-loop corrections. Add item (4) to the term list of ch06 l.354ff: graphs with the vertex (Q O(eps)+{I-I^CT,O(eps)}_eps+hbar Delta_eps O(eps)) and one vertex S^(1)(Delta).

findings.target: ch05 Def def:c5-Oeps and Rem rem:c5-content; ch06 Thm thm:c6-dil, Cor cor:c6-dilcomp; ch00 l.30 ('anomalous dimensions are classes'); ch07 'Step 2' list
findings.gap: Reading the dilatation component as an anomalous dimension of a cohomology class needs O[inf] to be a cocycle at arity zero: Q O[inf] = 0 at order hbar. This is the delta-linear part of the QME of the family I+delta O. It is neither computed nor assumed, and it is not in the Step-2 list. At one loop Q O[inf] is the flow of {I,O}_eps-{I,O} (special edge K_eps-K_0 between I and O), -Q partial_delta I^CT - {I,partial_delta I^CT}_eps, -{I^CT,O}_eps, plus trees of O with the action defect, whose cubic sector is open (Rem c4-cubic). For the weight-2 bilinears the allowed local output of ghost number 1 includes int omega (dc, A|_V)-type terms. If nonzero, these need a finite counterterm of weight 2, e.g. a multiple of int omega (A|_V,A|_V), since Q int omega (A|_V,A|_V) = -2 int omega (dc,A|_V). Such a term is scale covariant and leaves the one-loop coefficients 0 and -24 unchanged, but the cocycle condition must be stated.
findings.fix: Add a definition or remark in ch05: the operator QME Q O[inf] = 0 (arity 0, order hbar), with the graphs listed above and the possible finite counterterms of weight w_O. Add it to the Step-2 objects in ch07. In ch06 note that the coefficients are unchanged by finite weight-w_O counterterms.

findings.verdict: REFUTED (second bullet incomplete for the letters A|_V and lambda)
findings.gap: For the letters, the second bullet says the term linear in the first derivative of v is 1/4 div v(x_0) times a density of weight w_O. For O = int omega (X, iota_{v_2} A|_V), the antisymmetric part a of dv(x_0) gives the equivariant, weight-1 term (X, iota_{a v_2} A|_V). For O = int omega (zeta, lambda) it gives (zeta, rho(q(a)) lambda). Both are present classically, through L_v A and 1/4 rho(d(v,-)) lambda in S^(1)(v), and both are allowed by every selection rule. The bullet excludes the rotation part only for the scalar bilinears.

findings.target: ch07 l.3 ('This chapter proves both statements'); ch00 l.113 (Chapter 7 bullet); ch07 table rows 'can be chosen classical'
findings.gap: 'These components can be chosen with no one-loop correction' appears only in Rem c7-internal, as a statement whose realisation (arity-one counterterms, internal insertions) is deferred to Step 2. It is not proved, and it is false for gauge-variant O (T3-04). findings.target: ch05 Lemma lem:c5-log (proof, l.168-183); ch06 Prop prop:c6-Leps (proof, l.303)
findings.gap: (i) 'By dominated convergence' does not cover the lower-degree numerator terms: after rescaling they carry eps^{(2E-4-k)/2}, and their q-integral near the merging points -eps^{1/2}p_e grows like a power of eps (log for E=3). The limit is still 0, as eps times log eps, but this needs a separate bound. (ii) The step from lim eps dF/deps = b to 'F = b log eps + (limit)' needs a remainder rate; the proof cites [C07, Def 7.1.1, Thm A], which is for compact M and finite T and is not stated for R^4 at T=infinity.
findings.fix: Bound the lower-degree terms explicitly by O(eps log eps). Prove the expansion of one-loop graphs in powers of eps^{1/2} and log eps on R^4 directly from the Schwinger form (same lemma as T3-03), instead of citing Thm A.

findings.target: ch06 Def def:c6-tree (l.84-90), Lemma lem:c6-bvexact (l.156), Cor cor:c6-fieldredef
findings.gap: The tree insertion of an odd F into an odd functional, such as F into ((Q+{I,-})O)[inf], depends on the order of the odd parameters (eta zeta versus zeta eta). Def c6-tree gives a formula only for even F. The sign of the last term of eq c6-bvexact is therefore convention dependent. It affects only the 'terms built from (Q+{I,-})O'.
findings.fix: Define the tree insertion of odd F into a functional X as the coefficient of eta zeta in W(P, J + eta F + zeta X), or equivalently as partial_zeta partial_eta, and propagate the sign.

findings.target: ch03 Rem rem:c3-class (l.213) vs ch05 Thm thm:c5-Oeps (vacuum term) and ch00 l.82, l.88
findings.gap: ch03 says the functionals are taken modulo constants. ch05 keeps the field-independent term 2 hbar dim g (w_1,w_2)/(16 pi^2 eps) int omega in partial_delta I^CT and in O(eps), where it is the finite and meaningful subtraction of <O>.

findings.target: ch06 Thm thm:c6-dil table row 'transverse part' (l.239), Rem rem:c6-AV (l.251); ch00 table row 'letter A|_V, transverse part'
findings.gap: Thm c6-dil assigns the coefficient to O itself. The transverse part of a letter is nonlocal and is not an operator of Def c5-family. Because the 'terms built from (Q+{I,-})O' contain the longitudinal part of O (T3-04), the coefficient of O for this letter is defined only after these terms are specified. Rem c6-AV's 'it cancels the coefficient on that part' gives no computation, and the hbar^0 trees of T3-04 are not included.
findings.fix: Either compute the longitudinal cancellation explicitly (normalisation: 4 times the unit times the insertion of 2 int(A,A^*) through the c-A^* edge equals +8 units times the longitudinal projection), or present the A|_V row as 'the coefficient modulo terms built from (Q+{I,-})O'.

findings.gap: A single external lambda (weight 3/2, superficial degree 1/2 >= 0) is not excluded. It is excluded by parity or Lorentz invariance, but the proof does not say so. 'A cycle that enters ([A,c],A^*) along A|_Wperp continues along c or A^*|_Wperp, and P has no c x A^*|_Wperp component' is imprecise: continuing along c is possible through the c x A^*|_V edge, but then the A^*|_Wperp leg is external, of weight 3, which is excluded.

findings.target: ch00 l.38-42 ('Every singular or anomalous coefficient of this manuscript is carried by such boundary edges')
findings.gap: The QME obstruction of ch04 is carried by special edges K_eps-K_0, with Schwinger time in [0,eps], and by the counterterm vertex -Q I^CT[eps], which supplies the +9/2 eps^{-1}. The dilatation coefficients also use the scaling of the eps^{-1} counterterms and the removed Q-term of the Step-2 identification.
findings.fix: '... is carried by edges pinned at t=eps (L_eps), by special edges K_eps-K_0, and by the counterterm vertices -Q I^CT[eps]-{I,I^CT[eps]}_eps.'

findings.target: ch05 l.32; ch03 Def def:c3-delta (l.218); ch03 Rem rem:c3-story
findings.gap: Delta_inf=0 and {-,-}_inf=0 are established as limits t->inf only on functionals whose contracted Taylor components are integrable kernels. They are then applied to the nonlocal O[inf] and I[inf], whose kernels decay like |x|^{-2} and lie outside that class (the t->inf limit of {F,G}_t is not controlled there).
findings.fix: Define the scale-infinity structure by the kernel K_inf := 0, so that Delta_inf = -partial_0 = 0 identically, as is already done in Thm c3-uv (QP(eps,inf) = K_eps exactly), and do not present it as a t->inf limit.

findings.target: ch07 road ahead (l.365: 'it is a local functional, closed ...'); ch04 l.712 (identification of lim Q W with the obstruction of [C07, Prop 12.0.3])
findings.gap: The eps->0 limit of the graphs with one defect vertex includes trees of I attached to the defect, so it is not local in general. The local object is the effective defect vertex, the C07-type obstruction, and lim QW is its flow to scale infinity. In the (c,A|_V) sector at one loop the two coincide, so Thm c4-obstruction is unaffected. Locality and closedness are asserted by citing [C07, Lemma 12.0.4], which is for compact M.
findings.fix: '... the one-loop obstruction is a local functional Ob whose flow to scale infinity equals lim Q W; Ob is closed for ...; on R^4 at T=infinity this is to be proved in Step 2.'

summary.headline: No sign or normalisation error in the computed numbers. Counterterms, QME obstruction, O(eps), scaling covariance and dilatation (0 and -24 units; Konishi positive) are confirmed. The refutations concern scope and proof: ch00 summary accuracy (Ch2 stale, acyclicity), the locality/power-counting lemma that ch04/ch05 use but do not prove, gauge-variant operators in the Step-2 identification (Prop c6-classical, Rem c7-internal), the missing operator cocycle condition Q O[inf] = 0, and the rotation terms missing in Cor c7-K for the letters A|_V and lambda.
